about: Corrected inputs for cases whose pre-registered input was refused, written after the first run (D950). Reported separately from the pre-registered result; the expectation is the pre-registered one.

cases.why: The pre-registered input named method direct and costs; the ACFTA text has only the build-down formula and the check refuses method direct as invalid input. Re-run with the method and costs left out (the 42.2 % is the same by build-down: (2,250 - 1,300) / 2,250).
cases.expect_why: Build-down is the only ACFTA method, so the stated 42.2 % is read as the indirect figure.
